item.title: How to sort tables in Angular
item.description: Sortable tables help users find data quickly by ordering rows based on any column. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built sortable data tables for enterprise dashboards handling thousands of rows. The most effective approach tracks sort column and direction in component state, uses a getter to return sorted data, and shows directional indicators on column headers. This provides intuitive sorting without external libraries.

item.title: How to make tables sortable in React
item.description: Sortable tables enhance user experience by enabling dynamic data organization, especially crucial for dashboards and data-heavy applications. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented sortable tables in countless enterprise React applications. The most effective approach is managing sort state with useState and applying sort logic to reorder table data. This method provides responsive sorting with clear visual feedback and maintains clean component structure.

item.title: How to sort a table in Vue
item.description: Implementing table sorting allows users to organize data by any column, essential for data-heavy Vue applications and dashboards. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built sortable tables in countless enterprise applications. The most effective solution is to use reactive state for sort configuration and a computed property to return sorted data. This approach provides efficient, reactive sorting with clear column indicators.

item.title: How to sort a list in React
item.description: Implementing sorting functionality allows users to organize data in React lists by any column, essential for data tables and organized content. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built sortable lists and tables in countless enterprise applications. The most effective solution is to track the sort field and direction in state and use the array sort method to reorder data. This approach provides flexible, client-side sorting with clear visual feedback.

item.title: How to handle sorting in Node.js APIs
item.description: Implementing sorting is essential for Node.js APIs that return lists of data, allowing clients to order results by any field. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built sortable APIs for countless enterprise applications. The most effective solution is to accept sort field and direction as query parameters and apply them to database queries. This approach is flexible, performant, and follows REST API best practices.

item.title: How to compare two dates in JavaScript
item.description: Comparing dates is fundamental for validation, sorting, and implementing date-based business logic in web applications. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented date comparisons in countless components including calendars, data tables, and form validation. From my expertise, the most straightforward and reliable solution is to use standard comparison operators directly on Date objects. JavaScript automatically converts Date objects to timestamps for comparison, making this approach both simple and efficient.
